name: sonarqube-mcp
description: The sonarqube-mcp server plus the code-quality workflow skill: quality gates, issue triage, security hotspots, measures and per-line coverage from SonarQube Cloud.

sonarqube_token.title: SonarQube Cloud user token
sonarqube_token.description: Created at https://sonarcloud.io/account/security — pick the User Token type, not a project analysis token. Leave it blank to read public projects anonymously.

sonarqube_org.title: Organization key
sonarqube_org.description: The last segment of https://sonarcloud.io/organizations/{key}. Needed to list projects and to read rule explanations; everything else works without it.

sonarqube_default_project.title: Default project key
sonarqube_default_project.description: The id in a sonarcloud.io project URL, not the repository name. Set it and the projectKey argument becomes optional on every tool.

sonarqube_read_only.title: Read-only mode
sonarqube_read_only.description: Set to 1 to leave the four write tools unregistered, so no model can transition, assign, comment on or close anything.

sonarqube_url.title: Base URL
sonarqube_url.description: Only wanted on sonarqube.us. Blank means https://sonarcloud.io; SonarQube Server is out of scope.
